gpt-4.1-mini.title: Vegetable Frittata
steps: Heat the skillet with the frittata until warmed through.
Serve warm as a hearty breakfast.

gpt-4.1-mini.title: Creamy Paprika Chicken Dinner
steps: Heat the creamy paprika chicken with vegetables in a pan until hot.
Serve as a complete dinner meal.

gpt-4.1-mini.title: Fresh Garden Salad
steps: Chop lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and carrot into bite-sized pieces.
Toss together with salt, pepper, and oil to taste.
Serve fresh as a light lunch.

gpt-5.4.title: Paprika Chicken Bowl
steps: Chop Broccoli Crowns, Carrot, and Snap Peas In green basket into bite-size pieces.
Sauté the vegetables in oil with salt, pepper, and basic spices until just tender.
Warm Creamy Paprika Chicken With Vegetables in a pan until hot.
Serve the creamy chicken over the sautéed vegetables.

gpt-5.4.title: Frittata Salad Plate
steps: Slice Homemade Skillet Vegetable Frittata and warm lightly if desired.
Chop Lettuce Head, Cucumbers, Tomatoes Roma and Cherry, and Avocado.
Toss the salad with oil, salt, and pepper.
Serve the frittata alongside the salad for a complete plate.

gpt-5.4.title: Turkey Cabbage Skillet
ingredients: Norbest Organic Ground Turkey 93% Lean | 7% Fat
steps: Brown Norbest Organic Ground Turkey 93% Lean | 7% Fat in oil with salt, pepper, and basic spices.
Add sliced Mushrooms In green basket and chopped Carrot; cook until softened.
Stir in shredded Cabbage Green and cook until wilted and tender.
Season to taste and serve hot.

gpt-5.5.title: Cajun Sausage Long Bean Skillet
ingredients: Thrive Market Organic Cajun Style Chicken Sausage Cajun Style, 12 oz
steps: Slice the sausage and brown it in a little oil in a large skillet.
Add sliced mushrooms, shredded cabbage, and Frozen Long Beans; cook until tender.
Stir in chopped Tomatoes Roma and Cherry, salt, pepper, and paprika; cook until the tomatoes soften.
Serve hot as a one-pan dinner.

gpt-5.5.title: Turkey Avocado Burgers
ingredients: Norbest Organic Ground Turkey 93% Lean | 7% Fat
Francisco International Hamburger Buns 16 count, 1 lb 14 oz (850g)
steps: Season the ground turkey with salt, pepper, and basic spices, then form patties.
Cook the patties in an oiled skillet until fully cooked through.
Toast the hamburger buns if desired.
Assemble burgers with Lettuce Head, sliced Avocado, and Tomatoes Roma and Cherry.

gpt-5.5.title: Shrimp Avocado Salad
steps: Thaw the shrimp, then cook in a skillet with oil, salt, pepper, and paprika until opaque.
Slice the avocado, cucumbers, clementine, and carrot.
Arrange Mixed Lettuce in bowls and top with the shrimp and produce.
Drizzle lightly with oil and season with salt and pepper.
